svg.text: Argo CD · Ignore-Differences Editor — Interaction Flow (argoproj/argo-cd#29330)
Steps 1–2 · Diff tab: five OutOfSync CRDs, inline “Ignore…” entry on the added row
Scope & pointer prefilled from the clicked row
Eliminates N of M open diffs · matching rows flagged “will ignore”
Steps 3–4 · Full editor drawer (Scope / Pointers / JQ / Managers) with live ‹ n/N › match navigation
Step 5 · Saved: matching rows turn grey “ignored”, cards show badges, green confirmation toast
Rows greyed “ignored” · card badge “1 ignored” · green toast
6 · Manage in Ignored Fields (Preview / Add to Rule)
Step 6 · Ignored Fields tab: rule list, form with validation, Preview Against Manifests
Esc / Cancel closes the drawer without saving · ‹ n/N › steps through multiple matches · match-count nav appears only when N > 1
